title: Maddie:
title_q: “Find What Sets Your Heart on Fire”
headline: Asked for one message to the world, Maddie goes quiet. Her answer is worth the wait.
story: Nick asks Maddie for one message to share with the world. She stops and thinks. We hold that silence, then go back: is she happy? Very. She feels blessed, and the people around her “love and champion” her. She reads the $10 Watsi card and says it looks like a great opportunity to help others.
Then we return to her thinking face, and she answers: “find what sets your heart on fire and stop at nothing to pursue that.” Bright, warm, a little playful.
do: Open on frame 1 with Maddie listening and <q>One message for the world?</q> as top text.
Keep the question text up through her thinking pause, so text never drops out.
Make the name super large. First name only: “Maddie”.
Use one small zoom-in on the last cut before “and stop at nothing”.
Blur any readable code on the card.
dont: Don't play her answer in the hook. Hold it for the end.
Don't use 00:15–00:23 (“when we put good out, we get good back”). It belongs to the compilation video.
No title card or logo at 0:00.
No more than 4 picture cuts plus the zoom.

bp_intro: Every source time below is in 20260922_C5084.MP4 (1:49, one camera) unless C5085 is named. Times come from the transcript and are accurate to about 1 s. Every frame is from the real file. The yellow box shows the 9:16 crop.

rows.frame_alt: Maddie listening, lips together, library steps behind
rows.visual: Maddie listens, lips together. Denim jacket, curly hair, the “Explore What's…” sign at lower left. Crop centered on her face.
rows.motion: Top text on frame 1: One message for the world? Lato Bold, white, soft shadow. Cut on.

voice.quote: and if you had one message to share with the world, what would you say?

rows.visual: Her thinking pause (C5084 01:29–01:31). Two seconds of no words. Do not play her answer.
rows.motion: Question text stays up through the pause. No caption here, because nobody speaks.

rows.visual: Cut back in time: Maddie answers with a big smile, eyes almost closed.
rows.motion: Top text changes to <q>Are you happy?</q> for 2 s (the series name). Captions on her answer.

voice.quote: are you happy? … I am, I am very happy.

rows.music: Soft, warm bed can start under her laugh. 18–20 dB under.

rows.frame_alt: Maddie talking, looking to her side
rows.visual: Same shot. She looks to her left and back while she talks.
rows.motion: Name super “Maddie” at 00:09.5–00:11.5, lower left, above the captions, large.

voice.quote: And why are you happy? … I am very blessed, I'm happy to be in New York City and I just have others around me that love and champion me well.

rows.frame_alt: Maddie reads the blue card in her hands
rows.visual: Maddie holds the blue card and reads it (C5084 00:37–00:48). She sits left of center: crop left. Cut the 2-second gap between her two lines. Option: 2 s of her hands with the phone and card from C5085 00:00–00:17, if it plays clean. Blur any readable code.
rows.motion: Top text, one line: <q>She was just given $10 to help pay for a stranger's surgery.</q>

voice.quote: So it's saying for patients who might need surgery and can't afford it. … Yeah, I mean it looks like a great opportunity to help others.

rows.frame_alt: Maddie looks to the side with a small smile, thinking
rows.visual: Back to the end of her pause (C5084 01:32–01:34).
rows.motion: Top text returns: <q>One message for the world?</q>

rows.frame_alt: Maddie looks up and to the side while she speaks
rows.visual: She says it slowly and looks up. One shot.
rows.motion: Top text out on her first word. Captions only.

voice.quote: I would say find what sets your heart on fire

rows.visual: Cut the 3-second silence (01:41–01:44) down to about 1 second. Hide it with a small zoom-in (105%). End on her smile at 01:46.
rows.motion: Captions only. Optional: color “heart” Watsi yellow #FFCC33, one time.

voice.quote: and stop at nothing to pursue that.

rows.visual: Live footage of her smile after the line (C5084 01:46–01:47). Mute Nick's “I love that”.
rows.motion: End card on the footage, same as the other Watsi x AYH posts: <q>Support a patient</q> · <q>Link in bio</q> · <q>Watsi</q>. One line at a time.
rows.music: Last note rings out. 1 s fade.
